core_obligations: Reduce to affine opens and the corresponding finite type ring map (proof lines 13417-13425).

Treat the additional condition under separatedness or quasi-compactness (proof lines 13453-13459).
difficulty_reason: The lemma gives five equivalent formulations of a dominant locally finite type morphism between integral schemes having finite degree: the function field extension has transcendence degree zero, is finite, is realised by a finite morphism over nonempty affine opens, the generic point of the source is the only point over the generic point of the target, and, when the morphism is separated or quasi-compact, the preimage of a suitable nonempty affine open is finite over it. The proof works with affine open pieces and the corresponding ring maps of finite type, translating each condition into a statement about the fraction fields and using the standard equivalence between finiteness of the field extension and the finiteness of the ring extension over a suitable localisation.
